title.en: 3D Printed Vegetable Fidget Toy Pop Eye Press Action Funny Interactive Desk Toy Creative Novelty Gift For Office Work Desk Decor

description.pc:
Basic Information

✅ PRODUCT TYPE 3D printed vegetable themed pop eye fidget and desk toy

✅ FOUR VISIBLE DESIGNS Carrot Eggplant Tomato and Potato styles are shown as optional variants

✅ PRESS INTERACTION The product uses a top press action to create a protruding eye effect with Tomato and Eggplant directly demonstrated in the product images

✅ VISIBLE STRUCTURE Each shown design combines a vegetable character two white cartoon eyes and a brown pot shaped base

✅ 3D PRINTED APPEARANCE Visible layered printing texture is part of the product appearance while exact material size and weight remain to be confirmed

Core Selling Points

🎯 PRESS FOR A FUN VISUAL REACTION

Press the top and watch the character change expression with an exaggerated pop eye effect. The simple physical interaction creates an immediate funny visual moment that works especially well as a desk side fidget.

🎯 FOUR VEGETABLE PERSONALITIES

Choose from Carrot Eggplant Tomato or Potato designs. Each version uses a different vegetable silhouette and color combination while keeping the same quirky cartoon style.

🎯 MADE FOR DESK SIDE FUN

The vegetable character and pot shaped base create a distinctive desk display even when the product is not being pressed. Place it beside a computer notebook or workspace as a playful interactive desk object.

Q&A

🎯 Q Is This A Soft Squishy Or Stress Ball

A: The product is shown as a 3D printed structure with visible printing layers. It should not be assumed to have the same soft body feel as a silicone rubber TPR squishy or stress ball. Exact material is currently not confirmed.

🎯 Q Do I Receive All Four Vegetable Designs

A: The product images show four optional designs rather than confirming a four piece set. Please follow the selected SKU and quantity shown in the order option before purchasing.

🛑 WARM NOTE

Exact material dimensions weight packaging and age grading are not confirmed in the current product information. Please refer to the final SKU data once verified.

Do not forcibly twist pull or bite the protruding eyes or top press structure. Use the product through normal hand pressing only.

Visible 3D printing layer texture is part of the product appearance. Keep the item away from excessive heat and clean gently without prolonged soaking unless the material specification later confirms otherwise.
